title: Patriots 53-man roster projection 1.0: Will New England really stick with 7 receivers?
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Patriots' 53-man roster could include seven wide receivers, with Kayshon Boutte's status uncertain.
Quarterbacks Drake Maye, Tommy DeVito, and Behren Morton are projected to make the Patriots' roster.
Veteran cornerback Carlton Davis is sidelined with an injury, prompting Patriots to carry additional defensive backs.

title: Adley Rutschman could make his Red Sox debut in coming days
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Adley Rutschman, acquired by the Red Sox on August 3, could debut against the Blue Jays this week.
Rutschman, recovering from wrist inflammation, played two rehab games with Triple-A Worcester last weekend.
Red Sox manager Chad Tracy says Rutschman will not play Monday but may join later games in Toronto series.

title: Healey signs bill allowing state to take Norwood Hospital through eminent domain
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: Gov. Maura Healey signed a bill allowing Massachusetts to seize Norwood Hospital through eminent domain.
The hospital has been vacant since 2020 after floods, and construction stalled when Steward Health Care filed for bankruptcy.
The state aims to transfer the hospital to a nonprofit to complete construction and reopen as a healthcare facility.

title: Dozens displaced by building collapse in Springfield
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: A building collapse in Springfield displaced 45 people after severe thunderstorms caused parapet failure and partial roof collapse.
Mayor Domenic J. Sarno declared a state of emergency due to the storm, which also led to power outages and downed trees.
The Red Cross is aiding displaced residents, and Eversource dispatched crews to address power outages in the affected areas.

title: Adam Vinatieri jokes about Bill Belichick, Deflategate as part of Hall-of-Fame speech
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Adam Vinatieri was inducted into the Pro Football Hall of Fame, reflecting on his 24-year NFL career.
Vinatieri joked about Bill Belichick, who was absent from the ceremony due to personal commitments.
The speech included humor about the Patriots' Deflategate and appreciation for fans and teammates.

title: Mass. 7-year-old hit and killed by vehicle while riding bike
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: A 7-year-old bicyclist was fatally struck by a vehicle at Main Street and Buxton Hill Road, Williamstown.
The child unintentionally entered Main Street, and the collision occurred around 5:40 p.m., officials reported.
No charges have been filed against the driver, who was not impaired, according to the Berkshire DA's office.

title: Residents urged to keep pets out of Stoughton pond after dog’s death
author: Darin Zullo
bullets: Stoughton officials warn residents to avoid Ames Pond after a dog's death, possibly due to an algae bloom.
E. Coli tests at Ames Pond have shown no issues, but rapid algae blooms remain a health concern.
Cyanobacterial algae blooms can cause illness in humans and may be deadly to pets, officials caution.

title: Former NH state trooper decertified after misleading police about using GPS to track girlfriend
author: Darin Zullo
bullets: Former NH State Trooper James Lamoureux resigned after misleading police about placing GPS trackers on his girlfriend's vehicle.
Lamoureux pleaded guilty to false reports, receiving a deferred six-month prison sentence suspended for two years.
Lamoureux will be listed on the national registry of decertified officers, prohibiting future law enforcement employment.

title: Man polishing powder horn outside Lexington church prompts bizarre police response
author: Darin Zullo
bullets: Lexington police responded to reports of a man with a gun at Grace Chapel on Worthen Road.
The man was found polishing a musket-era powder horn outside his vehicle, not posing a threat.
The incident led to a heavy police presence and a temporary lockdown of the church building.

title: Longtime sports analyst Rob Parker not sold that Red Sox will make playoffs
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Rob Parker doubts Red Sox will sustain performance and make 2026 playoffs despite strong recent results.
Red Sox currently hold second A.L. wild-card spot with a 96% playoff chance, FanGraphs indicates.
Boston had a historic turnaround, winning 32 of their last 38 games, but Parker remains skeptical.
